messages:
elaine: @here Quick update on Dedicated capacity — we just finished validation for a new GPU profile and expanded a couple of regions.

elaine: TL;DR: H100 (80GB, q8/amp) is available as a Dedicated SKU starting today in us-west-2 and eu-west-2. ap-southeast-1 added as a warm pool (limited).

matt: Nice! Any perf numbers vs A100? :eyes:

elaine: Short answer: ~1.8x throughput for llama-type models at 2K context vs our A100 baseline in our internal suite. Latency varies by model/seq. Full perf matrix & perf/price in the doc: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/h100-benchmarks

ops-bot: [system] Capacity inventory updated: H100-us-west-2 (40 units), H100-eu-west-2 (24 units), H100-ap-southeast-1 (warm pool 8 units). See /dedicated/inventory for live counts.

priya: If teams want to migrate workloads, what's the recommended path? auto-rollout or manual pinning?

elaine: Recommend pinning model version + using canary rollout. For throughput-sensitive endpoints use batching profile "h100-high" and enable KV prefix caching. We pushed templates to Console -> Dedicated -> Blueprints.

sanjay: Is this available for new Dedicated contracts only or can existing Dedicated customers request an upgrade?

elaine: Existing Dedicated customers can request an H100 upgrade. Please open the 'Dedicated capacity change' support flow (link in the doc). Expect lead time 2-6 weeks depending on region and commit.

liz: Are there any changed pricing tiers we should flag to finance and sales?

elaine: Yes — H100 SKUs are priced at a 1.6x multiplier over A100 baseline for reserved capacity. We added a short pricing FAQ in the doc. Finance + Sales pinged.

matt: Any immediate constraints customers should know about? quota, burst, fallbacks?

elaine: Two items: 1) ap-southeast-1 warm pool is limited — only burstable, not guaranteed for steady-state until inventory increases. 2) We added automatic fallback rules: if H100 capacity is depleted the routing policy can fall back to A100 or to a mixed-quantized variant to preserve availability.

priya: How do I test if my endpoint will actually run on H100 in my Dedicated cluster?

elaine: Run the quick check or use Console. CLI:
```
rw dedicated check-capacity --region eu-west-2 --gpu H100 --model ./models/llama-2-13b
```
If it returns AVAILABLE you can schedule a rollout.

sanjay: Will this affect Hosted API customers at all?

elaine: Hosted customers will not be automatically migrated. We will add H100-backed hosted tiers later this quarter; current Hosted remains on a mixed pool. No immediate change to Hosted SLAs.

liz: Can we get a short blurb for the public changelog? :) 

elaine: Marketing/Docs — I'll draft a customer-facing note tomorrow. For now the internal doc has the talking points.

matt: Thanks Elaine. One last ask: add an example cost delta per 10M tokens for common profiles so PMs can plan.

elaine: On it — adding to the doc this afternoon. If you need a seat on the H100 test cluster ping me and ops-bot will auto-provision for up to 3 users per team.

ops-bot: [system] H100 test cluster provisioning enabled. Request via /ops request dedicated-test-h100 {team: <team-name>}.

priya: Great, thanks! :tada:

sanjay: Thanks. Will forward to a couple of enterprise customers who asked about faster inference.

elaine: Thanks all — filing a follow-up thread later with perf snapshots and the exact KB links.
